locator: Eq. (1), p. 3; sample-mean estimate, p. 5 (printed 'Page N of 15' = PDF page)
issue: Eq. number checked: printed (1). Holds under the source's conditions: one horizon t* for all observations, no censoring before it, i.i.d. restricted times. The cap here is the next deployment, a common horizon only when deployments are evenly spaced; deployments within one run are not independent; and deployments the run ends before are dropped (the 'left-out-deployment rule' in the tex comment), where the source would treat them as censored. None of this breaks the 'form' claim, but the sentence implies more than the form.

claim: Time lost (wait under MTD less wait with no MTD from the same moment on the same seed) is a difference of restricted means, per Eq. 1.
quote:
In a two-arm clinical trial with sur-
vival functions S0 (t) and S1 (t) in the control and research
arms, respectively, the difference in RMST between arms,
locator: Methods, unnumbered display after Eq. (1), p. 3 (printed = PDF)
issue: Eq. 1 is a single restricted mean; the difference is the unnumbered Delta after it, defined between two independent arms' survival curves. The dissertation pairs each deployment with its own no-MTD counterpart (same seed, same moment) and averages the differences. The mean of paired differences equals the difference of means, so 'difference of restricted means' is correct algebraically, but the pinpoint names the wrong display and the pairing is the dissertation's design, not the source's.
